from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanySurplusReserve(BaseModel):
    """Surplus reserve (盈余公积) data extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company")
    surplus_reserve_value: float | None = Field(description="The surplus reserve numeric value as reported")
    surplus_reserve_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the value as reported, e.g., '元', '百万元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., 2024年第一季度")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the surplus reserve value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_surplus_reserves: list[CompanySurplusReserve]
